name: Open-loop LLC isolated gate bias with voltage doubler and Zener split
function: Generates a source-referenced +15 V / -3.x V gate-drive supply from 12 V using a half-bridge transformer driver, a low-capacitance transformer, a resonant voltage doubler and a resistor-Zener split.

inputs.name: +12V
inputs.description: regulated auxiliary input through a common-mode choke

outputs.name: SOURCE
outputs.description: rail midpoint tied to MOSFET source

operating_conditions: Up to 2 W at 25 degC (CGD15SG00D2 rating).
Switching frequency ~470-500 kHz set by R_T.

required_components.value_or_part: 15 V Zener || 20 k; 3.9 V Zener || 5.1 k

design_calculations.name: Rail split
design_calculations.expression: V_neg set by the lower Zener/resistor; V_pos = V_total - V_neg; check Zener current at min and max load

interface_requirements: Input from a regulated 9-34 V rail (UCC25800-Q1 range).
SOURCE must connect to the driven MOSFET's Kelvin source.
pcb_constraints: Transformer slots/notches to reach the required creepage (8 mm on CGD15SG00D2).
Primary and secondary planes partitioned with no copper crossing the barrier (PRD-08391 PCB Layout).
Common-mode choke at the module input with input capacitance between choke and converter (PRD-09301 §3.8).
validation_notes: Frequency relation recomputed (EC-008, 6 % from the stated 'approximately 500 kHz'); Zener split connectivity confirmed (EC-025). Load regulation is Wolfspeed's measurement only.
limitations: Open-loop output tracks input voltage and load.
Measured -3.3 V is below the 3.9 V Zener rating: split depends on load.

alternatives.trade_off: Fewer parts and certification; higher unit cost, less control of C_iso.
